The '''Bredon cohomology''', introduced by [[Glen E. Bredon]], is a type of [[equivariant cohomology]] that is a [[contravariant functor]] from the [[category (mathematics)|category]] of <math>G</math>-complexes with equivariant [[homotopy]] maps to the category of [[abelian group]]s together with the connecting [[homomorphism]] satisfying some conditions.
